title: rosa gallica var. centifolia
intro: Rosa gallica var. centifolia, commonly known as the Cabbage Rose, is a fragrant and ornamental rose variety native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica var. centifolia include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce stress and anxiety, and aid in digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
